## Profiler-only Milestone 1

This release establishes the safe measurement foundation for Bannerlord CPU optimization. It does not change gameplay, AI, campaign simulation, mission simulation, physics, pathfinding, input, targeting, damage, or save data.

### Included

- Bannerlord v1.3.15 module skeleton targeting .NET Framework 4.7.2.
- Conservative configuration with profiling disabled by default.
- Exact assembly MVID, target signature, and fragile-method IL fingerprint validation.
- Observation-only Harmony prefixes and postfixes with sampled timing and approximate allocation data.
- CSV and JSON reports, optional runtime overlay, throttled logging, and lifecycle teardown.
- Confirmed TOR campaign, mission, model, and UI profiling targets based on direct IL inspection.

### Status

This is an instrumentation release. It makes no CPU-saving claim yet. Profiling data from real campaign and battle sessions is required before any optimization patch is eligible to ship.
